The phased testing approach is sensible.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Promising – subscription-based model aligns well with the value proposition and targets a specific market segment.', 'Differentiation': '• Strong – the focus on verifiable provenance linked to specific standards and the potential for a public, machine-readable registry offers a unique approach.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Good – actively seeks validation through discussions with relevant organizations and planned test cases.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Good – proactively addresses security and privacy concerns and incorporates community feedback.'}}
